title: Reasons for the Four Seasons; Jersey Boys only works because it's at least

contact_edits.before: I have a favourite theory about the Four Seasons' establishing hits, Sherry and the even better Big Girls Don't Cry, which is that with the extreme and abrupt contrasts between their high highs and low lows, they're funny. Well, that's how they sounded to my generation in London, where we couldn't have cared whether they came from New Jersey or New York or New Orleans. I tried my theory out on Gaudio, but he wasn't having it. Well, he did admit that "some of our songs have been quite humorous," and he did admit that the bass voice owed something to the cartoon sound of Yogi Bear, who at the time was even more popular than Sherry. But, he says, "we don't allow parodies of any kind. We wouldn't want to make light of songs that have moved people." And, obviously, are moving them still. - Jersey Boys is onstage now at the Toronto Centre for the Arts. For tickets and show-times, visit dancaptickets.comor call 416-644-3665.
